description: Data centres: Nara Lokesh says Vizag's AI data centres will use additional Polavaram water, not residential supplies. The Andhra minister says dedicated pipelines, green energy and newer cooling technologies will protect water security and jobs across the state.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh IT minister Nara Lokesh allays fears over water usage for AI data centres in Vizag Lokesh slams 'misinformation' campaign Andhra Pradesh IT minister, Nara Lokesh
